source: Library of Congress, Sanborn Fire Insurance Map, St. Louis Vol. 12 (1938), sheet 62, image 04858_12_1938-0062
labeled_by: Claude draft from the LOC sheet image; spot-checked and approved by Baburaj, 2026-10-11
scope: Industrial, fuel, tank and vehicle-service uses, plus stores and warehouses for paint, hardware or building materials, plus every G.T. symbol. Excludes dwellings, general stores and flats, offices, clinics, banks, post offices, general/grocery/furniture/merchandise storage, and auto houses (A) with no other use. Groups (a field of tanks) are one entry.

definitions.gasoline_tank_count: Number of tanks the map labels as gasoline: G.T. / G.T.S. symbols, 'GASOL. STGE. TKS.', or a labeled gasoline tank. 0 means none drawn.
definitions.other_tanks: Tanks that are not labeled gasoline (water, grain, iron, fuel oil, etc.).
definitions.map_notes: Only what is printed on the sheet.
definitions.interpretation: Inference, not a map fact; never scored.

sheet_layout: S Broadway on the left, then Water St and the M.P. R.R. along Vulcan St on the right; E Steins at top, E Primm at bottom. Mostly dwellings, flats, stores and private auto houses.
false_positive_test: No G.T. symbols, oil houses or fuel tanks anywhere on this sheet. A model that reports gasoline tanks here is wrong.

buildings.label: SIGN PAINT'G
buildings.map_notes: 28 ft; wood floor. Corner of E Courtois.

buildings.label: TIN SHOP
buildings.map_notes: 14 ft; wood floor. Corner of E Primm.

buildings.label: CHESTER IRON & FOUNDRY CO. STRUCTURAL IRON WORKS
buildings.map_notes: Mutual risk. Shop 18 ft, earth floor, pilastered walls, steel trusses; pattern shop on 2nd floor; office (2 stories, 28 ft) at 224. Woodworking building behind: frame, 1 story, 12 ft, concrete floor. No watchman. Heat: stoves. Power: electric.

buildings.label: FOUNDRY (NOT USED) / CORE OVENS (NOT USED) / CUPOLA
buildings.construction: brick (core ovens fireproof; cupola house metal)
buildings.map_notes: Part of the Chester Iron & Foundry lot, south of the woodworking building. Foundry 14 ft, earth floor raised 7 ft, wood posts, marked NOT USED. Two fireproof core ovens marked NOT USED. Cupola in a 1-story metal house, 16 ft.
buildings.interpretation: Idle foundry: foundry sand, slag and metals possible.

verification.method: Claude read every block of the full-resolution image; Baburaj spot-checked the sign painting shop, tin shop, Chester Iron & Foundry, the idle foundry, and the absence of G.T. symbols against the map, and approved the file.
